feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: Meet Colombia's fuzzy 'water guardians'
entry.summary: High in the Colombian Andes, a growing number of volunteers are racing to save an unusual plant that helps supply water to millions — one tiny seedling at a time.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: President Trump is taking credit for the return of his close ally Jensen Huang as Nvidia's CEO, Nvidia's stock rose after Huang was reinstated, the Russia-Ukraine war is spilling into other countries.

entry.title: Bob Woodward reveals some of the anonymous sources behind his reporting in new memoir
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with Bob Woodward about his new book, "Secrets: A Reporting Memoir," in which he details his reporting on the White House, Supreme Court, CIA Operations and the Pentagon.

entry.title: Trump administration's plan to convert warehouses into ICE facilities face backlash
entry.summary: The Trump administration is facing fierce backlash for its newly resurrected plans to convert warehouses into ICE detention centers

entry.title: Families of sailors in the Middle East remain concerned about their mental health
entry.summary: Families say U.S. sailors in the Middle East are increasingly showing signs of strain as the U.S. Navy's commitment in the region shows no sign of ending.

entry.title: This group of seamstresses mends shirts to make chemo easier for cancer patients
entry.summary: Seamstresses in Ohio and other states are making zippered shirts for cancer patients so they can more comfortably undergo chemotherapy treatments.

entry.title: Oil slicks in the Strait of Hormuz are harming the environment
entry.summary: More than 600 oil slicks threaten marine life in the Strait of Hormuz as war and tanker attacks turn vital waters into an environmental disaster.

entry.title: Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia as CEO after scandal
entry.summary: Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia as CEO was followed by to a surge in the tech company's stock -- and the stock market.

entry.title: Yale professor discusses Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia's CEO
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep asks Jeffrey Sonnenfeld of Yale's School of Management what Jensen Huang's return as CEO of Nvidia means for the future of the company.

entry.title: 2 states sue Elon Musk's AI company for allowing chatbot to make sexualized deepfakes
entry.summary: Oregon and Virginia are suing Elon Musk's AI company, arguing its users can make nonconsensual deepfake sexualized images of real people using chatbot Grok.
